translations.Connect to your Grist instance to search: Connect to your Grist instance to search for documents and add links via Smart Picker
translations.The Grist integration connects Nextcloud:
The Grist integration connects Nextcloud to a self-hosted or vendor-hosted Grist account, providing a 
	unified search provider and a smart picker component for documents.
translations.To create an API key, go to the \"Develo: To create an API key, go to the "Developer" section of your Grist Account settings.
